description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of response categories for a study investigating the generalization from atomic skills to complex reasoning tasks. The chart contains four slices, representing “Atomic Skill Fail”, “Correct”, “Reason Error”, and “Question Misunderstood”. The “Atomic Skill Fail” slice is teal and occupies approximately 68.0% of the chart; the “Correct” slice is light gray and represents about 21.0%; the “Reason Error” slice is a lighter shade of gray and covers roughly 10.0%; and the “Question Misunderstood” slice is a slightly darker gray and accounts for approximately 8.0% of the chart. A legend is provided above the chart, associating colors with each category. Percentage labels are displayed within each slice, and the slices appear to be ordered clockwise, starting with the largest proportion and decreasing in size.
